_about: Survey and statistics questions (MICS 2021, NDHS 2024, the NBS MPI 2022 and the SBS MPI 2025): single indicators, comparisons with the national and zone figures, 'gaps' questions, Hausa. Expected values in surveys_checks.json were read from the report pages (the PDF text of the cited page), not from Kasafi's extraction. Part of the pre-deploy gate: uv run python evals/complex/run_open.py --file evals/surveys/questions.json --out evals/surveys/report.md
